thread:
dana: heads up — CI is failing on a couple of PRs because of mixed formatters. python files are `black`-formatted, JS got `prettier` changes but some auto-applied gofmt on generated protobuf JSON changed trailing commas.

sam: ugh, saw that. which PRs? i hit it on #3124 and #3130 while merging.

lina: fwiw, pre-commit changed on main last week to add the project-wide `end_of_line` rule and a new `json-format` hook. might be clobbering some files.

dana: exactly — the `json-format` hook is running `jq -S` which removes trailing commas in some test fixtures, but our go protobuf generator expects the commas in the golden files.

ben: can we make the hook skip `internal/proto/golden/`? quick patch would be `.pre-commit-config.yaml` exclude.

sam: i can do that, but i'd rather make the golden files canonical then revert the generator if possible. skipping feels brittle.

lina: proposal: add an allowlist in the hook config for test fixtures, and add a CI job that runs `./scripts/check-golden.sh` to auto-restore canonical format. that gives short-term safety and a path to normalize.

pre-commit-bot: pre-commit run on changed files: json-format failed on 3 files — see attached output. (automated)

dana: ok can someone open a small PR that 1) updates `.pre-commit-config.yaml` to ignore `internal/proto/golden/**`, 2) adds `scripts/check-golden.sh` (small script that diffs generated output vs checked-in), and 3) adds the CI job? i can review quickly.

ben: i can draft it — will include a short blurb in the job that warns if `jq -S` normalization would modify files and fails the job with a hint to run `./scripts/fmt-fixtures.sh`.

sam: if you're already editing the pre-commit config, please also add a comment referencing the generator and link the GH issue so future changes don't silently reintroduce this.

lina: also, let's add a small note in the contributing guide about `jq -S` behavior and golden files. saved me an hour today.

dana: perfect. ben, can you drop the draft PR link here when it's up? i'll do a quick pass and push it through today.

ben: yep, i'll aim for a draft in the next hour. thanks y'all. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks — once merged i'll rebase #3124 and #3130 and watch CI.

pre-commit-bot: draft PR created by ben: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3148 (automated note).

dana: awesome — merging once CI green.

lina: follow-up: after merge we should run a one-off formatting pass and open a separate PR to normalize non-golden fixtures. separate change so easier rollback.

ben: noted. adding checklist to the draft PR description.

sam: sweet. end-to-end plan looks good.
